review: independent emitted-token authority and draft allocation alias audit
scope: source audit; dynamic CPU equivalence gates recorded separately

findings.description: Unconditional stop/abort admission checks added to worker already-queued path and Backend.start; fifth mailbox regression rejects remote and local execution after pre-existing abort.

invariants: Only rank1 HALF result.token is appended to emitted tokens.
Draft result is range/position/sequence/status checked and used solely as a rank0 speculative input.
Rank0 acceptance requires equality with rank1 unchanged target result; mismatch undoes state and recomputes actual target token.
Rank1 never executes speculative HALF; target streams publication occurs only after rank0 acceptance.
EOS pending speculation is rolled back before completion.
Draft plan outputs bind private draft allocations; target shared output weights and RoPE are immutable read dependencies.
Draft hidden stream is copied from target streams into draft merge.hidden; target token preparation/history is never called.
Draft request reset retains allocation IDs/captures and never releases shared owner allocations.
receipt_metadata_review: post-request-only timestamp derivation; terminal rollback excluded, overlap signed separately, all-command union supplies conservative token-mode GPU idle lower bound; final dumps excluded from model timing
